claims.sentence: The BIOCLAIMS study assessed the fatty acid (FA) and lipid mediator composition in normal weight and obese individuals, and their response to chronic omega-3 FA supplementation.</jats:p></jats:sec><jats:sec id="S0029665120001998_sec_a2" sec-type="materials"><jats:title>Materials and methods:</jats:title><jats:p>AT biopsies were collected pre- and post-12 week supplementation with 1.1 g EPA + 0.8 g DHA/day or corn oil.
